certified_ppl_schema: certified_ppl is an object, never a bare number. A reproducible one carries stock, wired, corpus, corpus_sha256, corpus_bytes, seed, ctx, batch, ubatch, regime, date, run and recorded_by, and is written by scripts/certify.py from the run it just did. One whose corpus was never recorded carries value_unverified instead of stock and wired, corpus null and unreproducible true: the number is kept because deleting evidence is not honesty, and the key is named so that a reader expecting a certified pair fails instead of quoting it. A re-certification replaces the whole object.

certified_ppl.note: Corpus not recorded. This number predates scripts/certify.py: it was taken by a per-model launcher in lanceurs/differentiel/, which reads corpus/materialized/stage1/coding-repobench-p-e-0048.txt, but nothing wrote that down at the time and llama-perplexity does not echo --file into its log, so the text behind the number cannot be established from the evidence that exists. Its four siblings from the same batch were each measured against the current corpus on 2026-08-10 and none of the four matched, so this one is treated the same way. The certification_chain above is unaffected; it is this number alone that is ambiguous. Do not quote it and do not compare it to any other perplexity in this file. This model has no native stock reference on any Mac, so the object is cleared only by a certify.py run on hardware that can hold it.

code.system: You are a precise senior software engineer. Write correct, idiomatic, well-structured code. Explain briefly, prefer diffs and complete files. Follow the project's conventions.

scripting.system: You are an expert at shell, automation and glue scripts. Produce robust, portable scripts with clear error handling. Show the exact commands.

writing.system: You are a sharp, natural writer. Clear structure, human tone, no filler, no AI clichés. Match the requested register and language.

reasoning.system: You reason carefully step by step, weigh alternatives, and state assumptions before concluding.

general.system: You are Galactus, a helpful local assistant. Be concise, warm and useful.
